本站是由一位热爱《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》的独立玩家亲手打造的非官方游戏攻略网站。从 2023 年游戏发售起，我便投入大量时间深度游玩这款游戏，自行实测、截图、整理数据，历时数月完成了这套完整攻略。网站内容涵盖全 23 条主线任务、60 个情节挑战、152 座神庙坐标、120 个破魔树根位置、20 件武器融合方案、228 种料理配方、38 套套装强化攻略，以及 16 个 Boss 的完整打法解说。所有截图均为本人亲自游玩所得，坐标数据经过逐一核实，攻略文字由本人原创撰写。本站持续更新，欢迎通过邮件反馈攻略错误或提出建议。

This site is an unofficial game guide website built by hand by an independent player who loves The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom. Since the game's release in 2023, I have poured a great deal of time into playing it in depth, testing things myself, taking screenshots, and organizing data, and spent months completing this full guide set. The site covers all 23 main quests, 60 side adventures, 152 shrine locations, 120 Lightroot locations, 20 weapon Fuse builds, 228 cooking recipes, 38 armor set enhancement guides, and complete strategies for all 16 bosses. All screenshots were taken from my own playthroughs, coordinate data has been verified one by one, and the guide text is my own original writing. This site is updated on an ongoing basis; please feel free to report guide errors or make suggestions by email.
